text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I thought I heard somebody calling my<n>name, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems there's nobody here. Was I<n>hearing
things?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Could it have been... the statue of the<n>Three
Goddesses?
